title: UPDATE
description:
## UPDATE
`UPDATE` lets you modify existing rows in a table. The syntax is:
```sql
UPDATE table_name
    SET column = value, column2 = value2...
    WHERE condition;
```
**WARNING:** If you forget the `WHERE` clause, it updates EVERY row. That's bad.
```sql
-- updates only Steve's plan
UPDATE customers SET plan = 'pro' WHERE name = 'Steve';
-- updates EVERYONE's plan to pro. Oops.
UPDATE customers SET plan = 'pro';
```
